description: A shell script for installing and configuring the openclaw project, including version resolution, environment setup, model configuration, and running end-to-end tests with different AI models.

methods.name: set_image_model
methods.description: Attempts to set the image model from a list of candidates using openclaw.

methods.name: set_agent_model
methods.description: Attempts to set the agent model from a list of candidates using openclaw.

methods.name: write_png_lr_rg
methods.description: Generates a PNG image with left and right color regions and writes it to a specified file.

methods.name: run_agent_turn
methods.description: Runs an agent turn with a specified profile, session, prompt, and output JSON file.

methods.name: assert_agent_json_has_text
methods.description: Checks if the agent JSON output contains text payloads.

methods.name: assert_agent_json_ok
methods.description: Validates the agent JSON output for success status and provider correctness.

methods.name: extract_matching_text
methods.description: Extracts text matching an expected value from agent JSON output.

methods.name: assert_session_used_tools
methods.description: Verifies that specific tools were used in the session transcript.

methods.name: run_profile
methods.description: Sets up and runs an end-to-end test profile with specified parameters.
